description: Design for the next Objective Selector/RAM proxy. This replaces naive logit bias with robust empirical action scoring.

motivation.v0_result: Objective Selector/RAM proxy v0 degraded performance relative to raw PPO.
diagnosis: Hand-coded logit bias can override useful PPO preferences.
Small-n oracle gap estimates are unreliable.
The selector did not explicitly optimize reach speed, stability, and energy proxy as separate metrics.
RAM uncertainty was recorded but not used as a robust penalty.

selector_score.form: Score(a, terrain) = beta_v * S_reach_speed + beta_s * S_stability + beta_e * S_energy - lambda_u * U_ram - lambda_var * Var_empirical

success_criteria.earth: Match best fixed baseline and raw PPO while preserving low drift.
success_criteria.stairs_single: Recover or exceed fixed_trot_mid performance without low-level modification.
success_criteria.tracer_sponge_firm_flat: Preserve raw PPO reach success while explicitly reporting high hold risk.

implementation_plan: Build per-world per-action empirical metric table from repeated rollouts.
Estimate mean and variance for reach/stability/energy/speed terms.
Apply uncertainty-aware robust score instead of hard-coded logit bias.
Use Objective Selector beta to change the score weights, not to directly force actions.
Use RAM proxy uncertainty as a penalty or top-k gating signal.
Evaluate against controller-only and raw high-level PPO baselines.
